title: Lesson 7. Shopping habits
subtitle: Существительные только в ед. или только во мн. числе; интервью с моделью

sections.title: 1. Nouns: only singular or only plural
sections.text: Some nouns are used only in the {plural}: {trousers}, {jeans}, {shorts}, {clothes}, {scissors}, {glasses}. They take a plural verb: My old trousers {are} a little tight. To count them we say {a pair of}. Some nouns are {uncountable} and singular: {news}, {money}, {mathematics}, {time}, {tea}. They take a singular verb: The news {is} good today! Money {doesn't} grow on trees. Time {is} money.
chain: The news is…, My trousers are…

sections.title: 2. Kade Massey's interview
sections.text: Kade Massey is one of the most promising British {models}; he is {15}. He has been working as a model {since} he was 12, so for {more than 3 years}. He usually shops in {London}. He bought designer jeans in {Milan}. His favourite buy of the year is a {striped} brown {jacket}. He never goes anywhere without his {sunglasses} and swimming shorts. For Christmas he has bought two pairs of {gloves} and a silk {scarf} for his mum, and a pair of trainers for his younger {brother}.
chain: shops in London, jeans from Milan

sections.title: 3. Useful phrases
sections.text: I almost always buy something in the end, but I'm not a {shopaholic}. If something {catches my eye} and is good enough, I just have to buy it. I {used to} buy cheaper clothes. I prefer to buy clothes {myself}. And I don't mind it {at all}. How {much} do you spend on clothes? What is the {best} thing in your wardrobe?
chain: catch my eye = бросаться в глаза
I don't mind it at all

flashcards.a: Только множественное: My trousers are tight.
Неисчисляемое, ед. число: The news is good.
a pair of: a pair of jeans, two pairs of trousers.

flashcards.q: My checked pyjamas … coffee stains on them.
Mathematics … always been my weakest subject.
Сколько лет Kade Massey и как давно он модель?
flashcards.a: Ему 15; он работает моделью с 12 лет, более 3 лет.

timeline.title: Только мн. число
timeline.text: These skinny jeans are too tight. My trousers are a little tight.

timeline.title: Неисчисляемые, ед. число
timeline.text: The news is good. Money doesn't grow on trees. Mathematics has always been my weakest subject.

timeline.title: Парные предметы
timeline.text: This pair of glasses is broken. A pair of trainers.

timeline.title: Только мн. число
timeline.text: The scissors have been missing again. My checked pyjamas have coffee stains.

quiz.q: Kade Massey has been a model … he was 12.
